aboutTitle: People have always been at the heart of my work.
aboutText: For nearly 30 years, I have accompanied leaders, business owners and families through decisions, relationships and life transitions. I am Brazilian and based in England, with experience working across countries and cultures.
aboutText2: I bring that perspective to a personal mentoring relationship. My work begins with listening: understanding your situation, exploring what matters and helping you consider what comes next.
pastor: I also serve as a pastor. My professional mentoring through Vellora Connect is independent of any church.
values: I bring perspective built over nearly three decades.
I seek to understand before offering direction.
I build relationships grounded in confidentiality.
faqs: No. I offer mentoring: a space to reflect on leadership, decisions and life transitions. If you need specialist support, I encourage you to work with a qualified professional.
Confidentiality is central to how I work. We agree on its scope and any legal or safeguarding exceptions before we begin.
How does the first conversation work?
We have a free, 30-minute conversation. I listen to what brings you here, answer your questions and explore the next step with you. There is no obligation to continue.
Yes. I offer sessions online, with in-person formats in London arranged by agreement.
I work with leaders, business owners, professionals, individuals and families seeking perspective on decisions, relationships or a new phase of life.

privacySections: The legal operator and official privacy contact will be published here before online enquiries are enabled.

Once enabled, the enquiry form will ask for your name, email, optional phone number, your context and your message to respond to your request and discuss mentoring. Please avoid sending sensitive personal information.

The controller must confirm the lawful basis, Formspree account, international transfer safeguards and a defined retention period before activating the form. No enquiries are currently transmitted or stored by this website.

Under UK data protection law, you may have rights to access, correct, delete or restrict processing of your information, object to processing and request portability. You can raise a concern with the Information Commissioner’s Office at ico.org.uk. An official contact will be added before data collection starts.

No analytics or advertising cookies are used. Your language preference is stored locally in your browser. The hosting provider may process technical access logs under its own privacy terms. All fonts and images are served from this website.
This notice must be completed with the operator’s details before enquiry channels are activated. Last updated: 13 October 2026.
